title: The Hour Before Boarding
lessons: what you reach for when no one is selling a solution
readiness can mean preparation or permission to pause

text: Gate 34 has delayed itself into an hour.
The terminal offers outlets, fluorescent weather, and a view of planes leaving without you.
Nobody asks what you need. You get to find out.

choices.text: Open the book you packed and read until boarding.
Check the gate, charge everything, and make a small plan.

text: The announcement interrupts a paragraph, not a crisis.
You close the cover with a finger holding your place.
Your battery is full. Your route is clear.
For a few minutes, that is enough certainty.
